subject: Ambulance Service Transition and Contract Dispute
overview: The Council demanded transparency regarding the city's transition to a new ambulance provider and a related financial dispute, while also evaluating the municipal response to a major January snowstorm. Members also approved annual Community Preservation Act funding recommendations and emergency heating repairs for a fire station.

items.title: Approval of Records
items.summary: Approved the meeting records from January 20, 2026.

items.title: Vacant Building Ordinance Committee Report
items.summary: Referred a report regarding a proposed vacant building ordinance back to the Planning and Permitting Committee for further public feedback.

items.title: Law Enforcement Identification and Fourth Amendment Rights
items.summary: Referred a resolution to establish policies prohibiting law enforcement disguises and protecting constitutional rights against warrantless entry to the Public Health and Community Safety Committee.

items.title: New City Charter Implementation
items.summary: Referred a resolution to discuss the implementation of the new city charter and its impact on Council practices to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Public Hearing: National Grid Grant of Location at 57 Swan Street
items.summary: Continued a hearing for a proposed utility pole installation to February 24th after the City Engineer recommended denial, citing concerns about density and available private property alternatives.

items.title: Common Victualler's Licenses
items.summary: Approved a license for Placita Mexico Tacos but tabled the application for Lighthouse Cafe because the petitioner was not present.

items.title: Neighborhood Ward Meetings
items.summary: Referred a proposal to host neighborhood-based council meetings to the Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee following public debate regarding the independence and political nature of the sessions.

items.title: Ambulance Service Transition and Contract Documentation
items.summary: Approved a formal demand for written answers and contract documentation from the administration following reports that the former provider is seeking the return of $188,000 in unspent funds. The matter was also referred to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: January 2026 Snowstorm Response Evaluation
items.summary: Referred a request for a comprehensive report on snow removal costs, staffing constraints, and communication failures to the DPW and the Public Works Committee.

items.title: Engine 5 Heating System Replacement
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of $97,500 from the Capital Stabilization Fund for emergency heating repairs at the Engine 5 station.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2026 CPA Appropriation Requests
items.summary: Approved the Community Preservation Committee's annual funding recommendations after clarifying the eligibility of historic local churches for preservation grants.

items.title: Leary Firefighters Foundation Equipment Donation
items.summary: Accepted a donation of self-rescue bailout kits valued at $19,573 for the Fire Department.
